narr: Early morning convection anchored over a ridgetop and produced a localized area of heavy rainfall. The run off produced flash flooding downstream to the northeast of Elizabethton.
ev: Several roads were closed due to high water or fast moving water in the Stoney Creek area northeast of Elizabethton.
Video depicted fast moving water on a homeowners property on Grindstaff Hollow Road near Sadie.
lsr: VIDEO SHARED ON TWITTER BY WCYB-TV OF FAST MOVING WATER ON A HOME OWNERS PROPERTY ON GRINDSTAFF HOLLOW ROAD ON THE NORTHEAST SIDE OF ELIZABETHTON.
